questions.question: In STAR-CCM+, which type of boundary condition is BEST suited to simulate a solid wall with no heat transfer?
answers: Convective heat transfer boundary condition.
Adiabatic wall boundary condition.
Isothermal wall boundary condition.
Heat flux boundary condition.
feedbacks: Convective heat transfer boundaries allow for convective heat transfer.
Adiabatic wall conditions impose zero heat transfer.
Isothermal wall boundaries impose a constant temperature.
Heat flux boundaries impose a heat flux at the wall.
questions.explanation: An adiabatic wall condition represents a boundary with no heat flux, which is suitable for modeling solid walls that do not exchange heat with the fluid.
